outcome: Caesarean section surgical site infection (SSI) rate
cohort: Patients who underwent Caesarean sections within the study's hospital trust between June-August 2012 and 2019.
finding: The implementation of a midwifery-led prevalence program and targeted interventions reduced the Caesarean section surgical site infection rate from 26% (June-August 2012) to 8% (by 2019).
